description: Prompt studio trial run: answer one question with a given prompt through the same pipeline and model as production. For scene=interview give question, optionally with a resume (list_resumes), target role and knowledge bases (list_knowledge_bases); for scene=exam pick a built-in question (examPresets from get_prompt_presets) or pass screenshots as base64. An empty prompt runs the built-in default. Charges nothing and saves nothing, but the account must have time available; rate-limited. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:write.)
name: run_prompt_trial
